name: Nordic Council (until 2016)
description: A white field charged with a blue disc bearing a stylised white swan in flight, above the word 'norden' in blue lower-case letters.
history: The swan emblem by the Finnish artist Kyösti Varis was adopted in November 1984 and first used officially in Reykjavík in March 1985; the version paired with the 'norden' wordmark was approved in 2004. It was replaced on 1 November 2016 by the current flag with a redrawn swan on a blue field.

features.role: stylised swan with eight wing feathers
features.symbolism: the swan of Nordic co-operation; the eight feathers are the five states and three autonomous territories
